title: Dictation Repair Book
user: A voice-dictation user with names, code terms, medications, or workplace jargon who needs corrections to reliably become private reusable vocabulary rules.
job_to_be_done: Turn explicit before/after transcript edits into private, inspectable, reusable vocabulary rules for clipboard dictation and Whisper.
success_measure: After 50 approved corrections, at least 80% correct transcription for the user's top 20 custom terms in a blind retest.
constraints: Never read arbitrary fields or retain audio by default
